description: This file handles mass editing save operations for vendors in the vtiger CRM application. It processes a list of record IDs, checks permissions, retrieves existing entity info, updates fields based on user input, and then redirects to a specific module view.

classes.name: CRMEntity
classes.description: Represents a CRM entity and provides methods to instantiate and manipulate CRM records.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Static method to get a CRMEntity instance for a given module.

methods.name: retrieve_entity_info
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific entity record by ID.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the current state of the entity object back to the database.
